units.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow
units.text: 5) junior municipal service positions.
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow
units.text: 3. A dual title for a municipal service position is permitted where the following duties are assigned:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow
units.text: 1) the duties of chief accountant to the head of a structural subdivision of a local self-government body;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow
units.text: 2) the duties of accountant to the relevant specialist of a local self-government body;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow
units.text: 3) the duties of legal adviser to the relevant specialist of a local self-government body.
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow
units.text: 4. In the cases specified in part 3 of this Article, municipal service position titles begin with “chief accountant”, “accountant” or “legal adviser”. The status and monetary remuneration of holders of these positions are determined by the second component of the municipal service position title.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow
units.text: 5. Municipal service position titles may be made more specific by adding designations indicating their specialization.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 9. Correspondence between municipal service positions and state civil service positions
units.text: Article 9. Correspondence between municipal service positions and state civil service positions
units.label: Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Correspondence between municipal service positions and state civil service positions
units.text: Taking account of qualification requirements, municipal service positions correspond to state civil service positions as follows:
units.label: Art. 9 · “Taking account of qualification requirements, municipal service…”

units.locator: Article 9. Correspondence between municipal service positions and state civil service positions
units.text: 1) highest and principal municipal service positions correspond to principal state civil service positions;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Correspondence between municipal service positions and state civil service positions
units.text: 2) leading municipal service positions correspond to leading state civil service positions;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Correspondence between municipal service positions and state civil service positions
units.text: 3) senior municipal service positions correspond to senior state civil service positions;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Correspondence between municipal service positions and state civil service positions
units.text: 4) junior municipal service positions correspond to junior state civil service positions.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 10. Qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions
units.text: Article 10. Qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions
units.label: Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions
units.text: 1. To fill a municipal service position, a person must meet the qualification requirements for the level of professional education and the knowledge and skills necessary to perform official duties, and, where the employer’s representative (employer) has made the relevant decision, requirements concerning specialty and field of training.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions
units.text: 2. Qualification requirements for the level of professional education necessary to fill municipal service positions are established by municipal legal acts on the basis of the standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions determined by this Law in accordance with the register of municipal service positions. Qualification requirements for the knowledge and skills necessary to perform official duties are established in a municipal servant’s job description according to the field and type of their professional service activity. A municipal servant’s job description may also specify qualification requirements concerning specialty and field of training.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions
units.text: 2.1. No qualification requirements concerning length of municipal service or work experience in a specialty or field of training are imposed for filling municipal service positions.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions
units.text: 3. Where a person is appointed as head of administration under a contract, a law of the City of Moscow and the charter of the municipal entity may establish additional requirements for candidates for that position.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 11. Standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions
units.text: Article 11. Standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions
units.label: Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions
units.text: 1. To fill a municipal service position, a person must meet the following qualification requirements:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions
units.text: 1) concerning the level of professional education:
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions
units.text: а) higher education for highest, principal, leading and senior municipal service positions;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions
units.text: б) secondary vocational education for junior municipal service positions;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions
units.text: 2) repealed by Law of the City of Moscow No. 2 of 29.01.2020.
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions
units.text: 2. Repealed by Law of the City of Moscow No. 19 of 16.04.2025.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions
units.text: 3. Repealed by Law of the City of Moscow No. 34 of 16.09.2009.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 11

units.text: Chapter 3. LEGAL POSITION (STATUS)

units.text: OF A MUNICIPAL SERVANT

units.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant
units.text: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant
units.label: Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant
units.text: 1. A municipal servant has the right to:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant
units.text: 1) familiarize themselves with documents establishing their rights and duties in the municipal service position held, criteria for evaluating the quality of performance of official duties, and conditions for promotion;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant
units.text: 2) the organizational and technical support necessary to perform official duties;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant
units.text: 3) receive remuneration and other payments in accordance with labor legislation, municipal service legislation and the employment agreement (contract);
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant
units.text: 4) rest, ensured through standard working (service) hours, days off and non-working public holidays, and annual paid leave;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant
units.text: 5) obtain, according to the established procedure, information and materials necessary to perform official duties, and submit proposals to improve the activities of the local self-government body;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant
units.text: 6) participate, on their own initiative, in a competition to fill a vacant municipal service position;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant
units.text: 7) receive additional professional education in accordance with a municipal legal act at the expense of the local budget;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant
units.text: 8) protection of their personal data;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant
units.text: 9) familiarize themselves with all materials in their personal file and with assessments of their professional activity and other documents before they are placed in that file, and have their written explanations added to the file;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant
units.text: 10) freedom of association, including the right to form trade unions to protect their rights and socioeconomic and professional interests;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant
units.text: 11) consideration of individual labour disputes in accordance with labour legislation, and protection of their rights and legitimate interests in municipal service;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant
units.text: 12) an official investigation, conducted at their request, to refute information connected with their municipal service that discredits their honour and dignity;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant
units.text: 13) visiting, in the prescribed procedure, bodies of state authority and state bodies of the City of Moscow, local self-government bodies, organizations irrespective of their organizational and legal forms, and public associations in the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant
units.text: 14) pension provision in accordance with federal law.
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant
units.text: 2. A municipal servant, other than a municipal servant holding the position of head of administration under a contract, may perform other paid work after giving prior written notice to the employer’s representative (employer), provided this does not give rise to a conflict of interest and unless otherwise provided by federal legislation and this Law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.label: Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 1. A municipal servant is obliged to:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 1) comply with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, the Charter of the City of Moscow, laws and other normative legal acts of the City of Moscow, the charter of the municipal entity and other municipal legal acts;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 2) conscientiously perform official duties in accordance with the job description;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 3) when performing official duties, respect human and civil rights, freedoms and legitimate interests regardless of race, ethnicity, language, attitude to religion or other circumstances, as well as the rights and legitimate interests of organizations;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 4) carry out instructions given by the relevant managers within their powers;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 5) consider citizens’ appeals in a timely manner and take decisions on them in accordance with federal law;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 6) comply with the internal labour rules, job description, procedures for handling official information and documents, and standards of official ethics established in the local self-government body;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 7) maintain a level of qualification sufficient for the proper performance of their official duties;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 8) not disclose information constituting state secrets or other secrets protected by federal laws, or information learned in connection with the performance of official duties, including information concerning citizens’ private lives and health or affecting their honor and dignity;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 9) safeguard state and municipal property, including property provided for the performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 10) submit, in the prescribed procedure, information about themselves and members of their family required by federal legislation;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 11) notify the employer’s representative (employer) in writing of the termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or citizenship (subjecthood) of a foreign state that is a party to an international treaty of the Russian Federation under which a foreign citizen is entitled to serve in municipal service, on the day the municipal servant learns of this, but no later than five working days after the termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or citizenship (subjecthood) of such a foreign state that is a party to an international treaty of the Russian Federation under which a foreign citizen is entitled to serve in municipal service;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 11.1) notify the employer’s representative (employer) in writing of acquiring citizenship (subjecthood) of a foreign state or receiving a residence permit or another document confirming the citizen’s right to permanent residence in a foreign state, on the day the municipal servant learns of this, but no later than five working days after acquiring that citizenship (subjecthood) or receiving that residence permit or other document confirming the right to permanent residence in a foreign state;
units.label: Point 11.1 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 12) comply with restrictions, fulfil obligations and observe prohibitions established by federal legislation;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 13) notify the employer’s representative (employer) in writing of any personal interest in the performance of official duties that may lead to a conflict of interest, and take measures to prevent such a conflict;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 14) take measures to prevent conflicts of interest from arising;
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 15) notify the employer’s representative (employer), prosecution bodies or other state bodies designated by federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation of all instances in which any person approaches the municipal servant with the aim of inducing them to commit corruption offences;
units.label: Point 15 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 16) inform the employer’s representative (employer) in writing of changes that have come to their attention in information contained in the questionnaire provided for by Article 15.2 of the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”, except information that changed as a result of a decision of the employer’s representative (employer) (hereinafter, information contained in the questionnaire).
units.label: Point 16 Part 1 Art. 13
